critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1909 _normalize_event is called on updates; if payload contains only category, only category→type sync applies. Good. But EventPayload uses model_dump() which fills every field with None → on PUT, None values overwrite existing fields (e.g. sending a partial update with only title still zeroes out description, location, image, etc.). Consider using exclude_unset=True on PUT or a dedicated EventUpdate model like NewsUpdate.
AgendaManager EventEditor should default group_targets to ['all'] and prevent an empty selection saving (empty list currently would be replaced by ['all'] server-side, OK, but UI hint missing).
/api/events filtering rebuilds role logic from scratch — extract into helper is_event_visible(emp, ev) for testability and consistency with /api/carousel + notifications when added.
